name: pysmt-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is pySMT, a solver-agnostic Python library for Satisfiability Modulo Theories. A
FormulaManager builds hash-consed, type-checked formulae over Booleans, integers, reals, bit-vectors, strings,
arrays and uninterpreted functions (wrapped by the `pysmt.shortcuts` API, with optional infix notation), and the
library walks, substitutes, simplifies, rewrites (NNF, CNF, prenex), analyses (free variables, atoms, logics,
size) and prints them, reads and writes the SMT-LIB format, and selects solvers, quantifier eliminators and
optimizers through a factory.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code under repair is the pySMT package pysmt/ except its solver installers (pysmt/cmd/install.py and
pysmt/cmd/installers/), the native bindings of the solvers that are not installed (pysmt/solvers/bdd.py, btor.py,
cvcfive.py, cvcfour.py, dynmsat.py, msat.py, pico.py and yices.py, and pysmt/optimization/msat.py, optimsat.py and
yices.py), pysmt/__main__.py and the test package pysmt/test/.
The documentation in scope is: README.rst, docs/getting_started.rst with the scripts in docs/code_snippets/ that it
includes, docs/tutorials/boolean_logic.rst, docs/development.rst, docs/index.rst, docs/api_ref.rst, and the module,
class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules of pysmt/.
